description: Ports appartenant à la Région Bretagne is a dataset listed in data.bretagne.bzh open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. Cette couche contient le positionnement des ports appartenant à la région suite au transfert de certains ports départementaux en 2017. Coverage: Brittany. The portal files it under Économie. Its keywords are Bretagne, Mer, Bateau, données ouvertes. The portal shows 22 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte : https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bretagne-bzh-portal.
